title: Electric Circuit: Complete Loop

serves.summary: The learner wires a battery, a switch and a bulb into one complete loop so the switch turns the bulb on and off, including finding and fixing a broken circuit.

request.objective: Wire a battery, switch and bulb into one complete loop so the switch controls the bulb (4-PS3-2)

problems.ask: Finish the circuit so the switch turns the bulb on and off.
problems.goal: One loop runs through the battery, the switch and both bulb contacts, so the switch controls the bulb.

wires: Wire 2: the tray to the tray
Wire 3: the tray to the tray
Wire 2: Switch B to Bulb side
Wire 2: Switch B to Bulb side
